fact: 西伯利亚大铁路已推进至太平洋：一条支线穿过满洲抵符拉迪沃斯托克，另一条南下至大连（Dalny）与牛庄；旅顺（Port Arthur）成为俄国在太平洋的军事支点。

sources.title: The Russian Road to China（Lindon Bates, Jr., 1938）Project Gutenberg eBook No. 77082
sources.quote: At length a railroad, pushed year by year, reached the Pacific. One branch cut across the reluctantly-accorded Manchurian domain to Vladivostok; another struck southward to Dalny and Niu-chwang. The Russian Eagles perched at Port Arthur and nested by the far Pacific.

fact: 当时银行界对西伯利亚大铁路的普遍评价是连年亏损：年总收入仅约2400万卢布，约为加拿大太平洋铁路的六分之一、南铁路的十分之一。

sources.title: The Russian Road to China（Lindon Bates, Jr.）Project Gutenberg eBook No. 77082 — 铁路财务
sources.quote: Statistically-informed bankers sometimes shrug their shoulders at the mention of the Trans-Siberian. "Every year a deficit," they say. "Gross earnings but twenty-four million roubles,--one sixth of the Canadian Pacific Railway; one tenth of the Southern Railway. _Hudoo_ (bad)!"

fact: 俄国政府向西伯利亚移民开放公共土地：有真实定居意愿的移民可在西伯利亚自选地点获得宽裕的宅基地，并以低于成本的票价经西伯利亚大铁路运送至定居点；除土地外还配给种子、粮食、工具以及最初数年的营销预付款。

sources.title: The Russian Road to China（Lindon Bates, Jr.）Project Gutenberg eBook No. 77082 — 西伯利亚拓荒政策
sources.quote: the public land has been put so efficiently and generously at the disposal of the people, that any emigrant expressing a genuine purpose of settling will be given, wherever he may select it in Siberia, a liberal homestead, and he will be conveyed to it over the Trans-Siberian Railway for a sum less than the cost. He is not only allotted his homestead, but he is supplied with seed, grain, tools, and advances for his first years of marketing.

fact: 俄国劳动条件的官方记述承认：工时“长得出格”，部分罢工曾被任意镇压；同时俄国劳动法与劳资争议处理安排在不少方面被认为具有政治家式的周全。

sources.title: The Russian Road to China（Lindon Bates, Jr.）Project Gutenberg eBook No. 77082 — 劳动条件
sources.quote: True, work-hours are unrighteously long and certain strikes have been put down arbitrarily. Still the Russian labor laws and arrangements for the settlement of labor difficulties are in many features conspicuously statesmanlike and just.

fact: 俄国曾长期拥有世界上最便宜的电报与铁路运价（甚于美国）——帝国基础设施的低价特征是穿越者交通与通信预算的宏观背景。

sources.title: The Russian Road to China（Lindon Bates, Jr.）Project Gutenberg eBook No. 77082 — 电信与铁路运价
sources.quote: It is still another credit that, despite Slavic limitations and financial loss, in the face of Western invention and competitive leveling, the country of the cheapest telegraph and the cheapest railway rate was until recently not America but Russia.
